claim: The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic on 11 March 2020.
label: true
rationale: WHO's Director-General made the pandemic characterisation in the 11 March 2020 media briefing.

ground_truth_sources.title: WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the media briefing on COVID-19 - 11 March 2020

claim: The Apollo 11 mission landed humans on the Moon in July 1969.
label: true
rationale: NASA mission records document Apollo 11's lunar landing on 20 July 1969.

claim: The Suez Canal opened to navigation in 1869.
label: true
rationale: Encyclopaedia and canal authority histories record the canal opening in 1869.

claim: The Paris Agreement was adopted in 2015.
label: true
rationale: UNFCCC records show the Paris Agreement was adopted at COP21 in December 2015.

claim: The euro became physical cash in circulation on 1 January 2002.
label: true
rationale: The European Central Bank records euro banknotes and coins entering circulation on 1 January 2002.

claim: The Earth is flat.
label: false
rationale: Direct observation, satellite imagery, geodesy, and spaceflight establish Earth as an oblate spheroid rather than flat.

claim: Vaccines cause autism.
label: false
rationale: Large bodies of epidemiological evidence do not support a causal link between vaccines and autism.

claim: Drinking bleach cures COVID-19.
label: false
rationale: Public health authorities warn that bleach is poisonous and should not be ingested.

ground_truth_sources.title: FDA warns consumers about dangerous chlorine dioxide products

claim: Barack Obama was born in Kenya.
label: false
rationale: Official birth records and contemporaneous documentation establish that Obama was born in Hawaii.

ground_truth_sources.title: Obama long form birth certificate - White House archive

claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the naked eye.
label: false
rationale: NASA has repeatedly addressed this as a myth; it is not visible from the Moon to the naked eye.

ground_truth_sources.title: NASA - Great Wall from Space myth

claim: Global surface temperatures have increased since the late 19th century, largely due to human activities.
label: true
rationale: NASA and IPCC summaries attribute observed warming primarily to human activities.

claim: Bitcoin is legal tender in El Salvador.
label: true
rationale: El Salvador's Bitcoin Law made bitcoin legal tender in 2021.

claim: Hydroxychloroquine was proven to be an effective treatment for COVID-19 in the general population.
label: false
rationale: Major clinical evidence and public health guidance did not establish general-population effectiveness for COVID-19 treatment.

ground_truth_sources.title: WHO recommends against hydroxychloroquine to prevent COVID-19

claim: The claim that masks reduce respiratory virus transmission is entirely unsupported by evidence.
label: false
rationale: The evidence base is mixed by setting and study type, but the absolute claim of no support is too strong and contradicted by public health reviews.

ground_truth_sources.title: CDC - Science Brief: Community Use of Masks to Control the Spread of SARS-CoV-2

claim: The UK left the European Union on 31 January 2020.
label: true
rationale: UK government and EU records place UK withdrawal at 31 January 2020.

ground_truth_sources.title: UK Government - The UK has left the EU

claim: The 2020 United States presidential election result was changed by widespread voter fraud.
label: false
rationale: Courts, election officials, and government security officials found no evidence of fraud sufficient to change the outcome.

ground_truth_sources.title: CISA - Joint statement on election security
Brennan Center - The Myth of Voter Fraud

claim: The lab-leak origin hypothesis for COVID-19 has been conclusively proven.
label: unresolved
rationale: Competing origin hypotheses remain debated; public evidence has not conclusively proven one origin pathway.

claim: Intermittent fasting is always superior to calorie restriction for weight loss.
label: mixed
rationale: Trials and reviews suggest intermittent fasting can help some people but is not uniformly superior to calorie restriction.

ground_truth_sources.title: New England Journal of Medicine - Calorie Restriction with or without Time-Restricted Eating in Weight Loss

claim: The Bronze Age Collapse has one universally accepted single cause.
label: false
rationale: Historical scholarship treats it as multi-causal and debated, not a single universally settled cause.

ground_truth_sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Bronze Age civilization
ground_truth_sources.note: Reference overview of period and collapse context.

claim: A company's stock price always rises after it announces layoffs.
label: false
rationale: Market reaction to layoffs varies by context; the word always makes the claim empirically untenable.

ground_truth_sources.title: Investopedia - How Layoffs Affect a Company's Stock Price
ground_truth_sources.note: Finance explainer on mixed market effects.

claim: Measles is more contagious than seasonal influenza.
label: true
rationale: Public health references consistently give measles a much higher reproduction number than seasonal influenza.

claim: The Treaty of Versailles was signed in 1919.
label: true
rationale: Reference and archival sources record the Treaty of Versailles signing in 1919.

claim: Humans and dinosaurs lived at the same time in ordinary human history.
label: false
rationale: Non-avian dinosaurs went extinct around 66 million years before modern humans.

ground_truth_sources.title: Natural History Museum - When did dinosaurs become extinct?

claim: The Federal Reserve was created in 1913.
label: true
rationale: The Federal Reserve Act was signed in 1913.

ground_truth_sources.title: Federal Reserve History - Federal Reserve Act Signed

claim: The MMR vaccine contains mercury.
label: false
rationale: CDC vaccine ingredient tables indicate MMR does not contain thimerosal/mercury preservative.

claim: The 1918 influenza pandemic killed more people than World War I battlefield deaths.
label: true
rationale: Historical estimates for the 1918 flu death toll exceed battlefield death estimates from World War I.

ground_truth_sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - World War I casualties

claim: NATO was founded in 1949.
label: true
rationale: NATO records the signing of the North Atlantic Treaty in 1949.

ground_truth_sources.title: NATO - A short history of NATO

claim: All cryptocurrencies are backed by government deposit insurance.
label: false
rationale: Regulators warn that crypto assets are not generally insured by deposit insurance schemes.

ground_truth_sources.title: FDIC - Crypto-Related Financial Products and Deposit Insurance

claim: The claim that red wine is always good for heart health is settled science.
label: mixed
rationale: Evidence around alcohol and cardiovascular outcomes is complex; blanket health-benefit claims are not settled science.

ground_truth_sources.title: WHO - No level of alcohol consumption is safe for our health

claim: A video appearing online tomorrow will prove who wins the next French presidential election.
label: excluded
rationale: This is a future-facing prediction and cannot be resolved by current evidence.
excluded_reason: future prediction; not scorable until an event occurs and evidence exists

claim: Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
label: true
rationale: Scientific and museum histories credit Fleming's 1928 discovery of penicillin.

claim: Smoking tobacco increases the risk of lung cancer.
label: true
rationale: Public health authorities and decades of epidemiological evidence establish smoking as a major lung cancer risk factor.

ground_truth_sources.title: CDC - Health Effects of Cigarette Smoking

claim: The human genome contains exactly 10,000 genes.
label: false
rationale: Reference genome resources estimate substantially more protein-coding genes than 10,000, and exact counts vary by annotation.

ground_truth_sources.title: National Human Genome Research Institute - Human Genome Project FAQ

claim: The Chernobyl nuclear accident occurred in 1986.
label: true
rationale: IAEA and historical records date the Chernobyl accident to April 1986.

claim: The Spanish flu pandemic began in 2018.
label: false
rationale: The 1918 influenza pandemic occurred a century before 2018.

claim: There is no evidence that seat belts reduce fatal injury risk in car crashes.
label: false
rationale: Road safety authorities report large reductions in fatal injury risk from seat belt use.
